vuln_id: ARVO arvo:36025 / Sleuth Kit APFS unchecked B-tree table offsets

bug_description.original: A vulnerability exists that causes a crash due to an unknown read in std::__1::enable_if<true, memory_view>::type.
bug_description.normalized: The staged 438276-byte APFS witness reaches `APFSJObjTree` construction for volume block 106. Static decoding of that saved image shows volume-superblock block 106 advertises `omap_oid = 101` and `root_tree_oid = 1028`, OMAP block 101 advertises `tree_oid = 102`, and object-map root block 102 is a fixed-key leaf/root node whose header sets `key_count = 1`, `table_space_offset = 0xffff`, and `table_space_length = 0x01c0`. Vulnerable `APFSBtreeNode<apfs_omap_key, apfs_omap_value>` accepts that block as an OMAP B-tree root and caches `_table_data.toc = _storage + 65591` and `_table_data.koff = _storage + 66039` without checking either pointer against the 4096-byte block extent. `APFSJObjTree` then asks `_obj_root.find(root_tree_oid)` for oid `1028`; because the malformed node is also marked leaf and has `key_count = 1`, the leaf search calls `key(0)`, and evaluating `_table_data.toc.fixed[0]` / `t.key_offset` triggers the reproduced AddressSanitizer `SEGV` / `wild-addr-read` at `tsk_apfs.hpp:401`.

source.description: First project-side materialization of the APFS volume metadata that selects the crashing object-map lookup.
source.value_from: Static parsing of the staged APFS `poc` shows volume-superblock block 106 stores `omap_oid = 101` at offset `0x80` and `root_tree_oid = 1028` at offset `0x88`; OMAP block 101 then stores `tree_oid = 102` at offset `0x30`, so this constructor chooses object-map root block 102 and lookup oid 1028.

relation.description: Source identity relation for the vulnerability-relevant value.

sink.description: AddressSanitizer crash site. Evaluating `t.key_offset` requires reading `_table_data.toc.fixed[0]` through the invalid TOC pointer materialized from block 102, producing the saved wild-address READ in `key()`.

root_cause.description: Root cause. The vulnerable constructor caches APFS B-tree table pointers without validating that `toffset()` or the later `koffset()` stay inside the 4096-byte block.
root_cause.note: The staged patch inserts explicit range checks immediately after `_table_data.toc`, `_table_data.voff`, and `_table_data.koff` are computed, throwing `invalid toffset`, `invalid voffset`, or `invalid koffset` before any table dereference. On the witness, `toffset()` is `65591` and `koffset()` is `66039`, so the new checks would reject block 102 before `find()` reaches `key(0)`.

tainted_value_origin.description: This assignment turns block 102's attacker-controlled `table_space_offset` into the out-of-block TOC pointer later indexed by `key(0)`.
tainted_value_origin.value_from: Block 102 header bytes `ff ff c0 01` at offsets `0x28..0x2b` decode to `table_space_offset = 65535` and `table_space_length = 448`. With `sizeof(apfs_btree_node) == 0x38`, `toffset()` becomes `65591` on a 4096-byte block.
tainted_value_origin.note: The same block is accepted as an OMAP B-tree root because its object type is `APFS_OBJ_TYPE_BTREE_ROOTNODE`, its subtype is `APFS_OBJ_TYPE_OMAP`, and its flags word is `0x0007` (root, leaf, fixed key/value).

parser_admitted.code: auto fs = new APFSFSCompat(img_info, pool_img->pool_info, pool_img->pvol_block, pass);
parser_admitted.description: After `tsk_fs_open_img_decrypt()` dispatches the pool image to the APFS backend, this call commits to APFS volume parsing on the hard-coded pool volume block 106 and enters the vulnerable object-tree construction path.

fine_trace.note: Source. Static parsing of the staged APFS image shows volume-superblock block 106 stores `omap_oid = 101` and `root_tree_oid = 1028`, and OMAP block 101 stores `tree_oid = 102`. This delegating constructor materializes those values together, so the later object-map search is performed on block 102 for oid 1028.

Block 102 is accepted as a root/leaf fixed-key OMAP node (`obj_type = 0x0002`, `subtype = 0x0000000b`, `flags = 0x0007`), but its header also gives `table_space_offset = 0xffff`. `toffset()` therefore becomes `0x38 + 0xffff = 65591`, so `_table_data.toc` is cached 61495 bytes past the end of the 4096-byte `_storage` block. The vulnerable source performs no bounds check here.

The same block-102 header sets `table_space_length = 0x01c0`, so `koffset()` becomes `65591 + 448 = 66039`. `_table_data.koff` is therefore another out-of-block pointer, again stored without any `> _storage.size()` rejection in the vulnerable constructor.

Block 102's flags word `0x0007` makes the object-map root a leaf with fixed key/value entries, and its header gives `key_count = 1`. When `APFSJObjTree` asks `_obj_root.find(root_tree_oid)` for oid `1028`, this branch is taken and the first loop iteration calls `key(0)`.

fine_trace.code:
const auto &t = _table_data.toc.fixed[index];
const auto key_data = _table_data.koff + t.key_offset;
fine_trace.note: Sink. `index` is `0` on the only loop iteration, so evaluating `t.key_offset` reads `apfs_btentry_fixed` entry 0 through `_table_data.toc.fixed`, whose base is `_storage + 65591`. That dereference is outside block 102, and the saved AddressSanitizer trace reports the resulting `SEGV` / `wild-addr-read` at `tsk_apfs.hpp:401` with stack `key -> find -> APFSObjectBtreeNode::find -> APFSJObjTree`.

For the witness, `_table_data.toc` would be `65591` bytes from the block start and `_table_data.koff` `66039`, both larger than `_storage.size() == 4096`, so the patched constructor throws `invalid toffset` or `invalid koffset` before `find()` reaches `key(0)`.

format.name: Apple File System (APFS) image
format.contract: The verified trigger is limited to the exact staged 438276-byte APFS image `poc` (sha256 `e30186f2cfdaaa6b38c6bec3a906bf31cc0736f29810e62a463cbfd90bdf590d`). Static parsing of that witness shows volume-superblock block 106 contains `omap_oid = 101` and `root_tree_oid = 1028`; OMAP block 101 contains `tree_oid = 102`; and object-map root block 102 is a fixed-key leaf/root node with `key_count = 1`, `table_space_offset = 0xffff`, and `table_space_length = 0x01c0`. Those exact fields make vulnerable `APFSBtreeNode` compute `toffset = 65591` and `koffset = 66039` on a 4096-byte block, so `_obj_root.find(1028)` enters its only leaf iteration and `key(0)` dereferences `_table_data.toc.fixed[0]` outside block 102. The staged evidence does not justify a broader APFS input class beyond this witness and these concrete header values.
